body:
## What this service is

Radical Storage is a booking network that pays local businesses (hotels, shops, restaurants, offices) to look after travellers' bags. You reserve a spot online, drop your luggage off and pick it up later. When we read the Bangkok page on 11 November 2026, it listed **43+ locations in Bangkok**, including points at **Suvarnabhumi Airport**, **Don Mueang Airport**, **Hua Lamphong (Bangkok) train station**, near the **Grand Palace**, and in Silom, Siam, Chinatown, Khao San Road and Sukhumvit.

This is most useful on a checkout day with a late flight, or for a day in the city between an overnight train and an onward bus.

## What it costs

The page headline says **from THB60 per day**, but most of the listed locations were priced higher. The page's price schema gave three tiers per 24 hours: **Small from THB110, Regular from THB150 and Large from THB210**. The FAQ adds that **a THB74.50 fee per bag is charged at checkout** to cover the guarantee and support, so budget for that on top of the daily rate. Examples shown on the page:

- **Hua Lamphong Station** (hotel), 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, rated 4.84 from 87 reviews, ฿110/day
- **Suvarnabhumi Airport** (local company), open 24 hours, rated 4.73 from 465 reviews, ฿110/day
- **Grand Palace** (hotel), open 24 hours, rated 4.84 from 139 reviews, ฿110/day
- **Ban Phan Thom** and **Pramot** (shops), ฿60/day with daytime hours only

## How it works

1. Search for a partner near where you will be and check its opening hours.
2. Book and pay online; confirmation arrives immediately.
3. Show the confirmation at the location and leave your bags.
4. Come back any time within opening hours and show the confirmation again to collect.

Each bag is covered by a **฿400,000 guarantee** against damage, loss or theft, and the page lists no size limits.

## What to check before booking

- **Opening hours:** many partners close in the evening (Silom 8:30 PM, Hua Lamphong 8:00 PM). For a late collection, choose a 24-hour location such as the airport or Grand Palace point.
- **Lateness:** minor delays are tolerated, but arriving well after your booked time, especially for pickup, can mean an extra fee from the location. The page offers a "Flexible hours" option at booking.
- **Cancellation:** you can cancel free of charge any time before the scheduled check-in and get a full refund, and edit the booking up to drop-off.
- **Ratings:** the 4.77 score from 578,516 reviews is network-wide. Look at each location's own rating instead.
